title: The Saga is documentation; approval happens only in reviews
statement: Stories, designs, test cases, and epic decks are documentation with no approvals and no comments; a review may reference them, and that is where a change to them is discussed and approved.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Stories, designs, test cases, and epic decks have no approvals and no comments, whether the Saga is observed or compared.
A review may reference documentation records, and that is where a change to them is discussed and approved.
